topic.title: Causal Structure Discovery from Observations and Interventions
topic.overview: Causal discovery seeks a graph of directional relationships from data rather than merely a predictive association. This topic studies conditional-independence tests, latent confounders, structural assumptions, interventional observations, and efficient searches over valid graphs. Identifiability and computational scalability are separate challenges: a fast search cannot recover information the observations do not determine.
topic.whyItMatters: Learned causal structure can organize hypotheses about a system and guide further experiments, but conclusions depend on assumptions about hidden variables, selection, and mechanisms. Interventions provide additional evidence while introducing questions about their targets, strength, and comparability across experimental settings.
topic.evolution: Early representatives investigate factorized causes and causal induction. A 2008 method uses local structure to reduce conditional-independence testing when latent causes may exist. Later work studies amortized and hybrid search. PACER in 2026 parameterizes acyclic graphs directly and combines observational and interventional likelihoods, avoiding soft penalties that permit cyclic intermediate structures.
openQuestions: Which interventions most efficiently resolve ambiguity among observationally compatible graphs?
How can discovery methods expose uncertainty caused by hidden confounding or misspecified mechanisms?

papers.tldr: CausalDynamics benchmarks causal graph discovery across thousands of dynamical systems with nonlinear, noisy, confounded, and delayed interactions.

papers.title: Characterization and Learning of Causal Graphs from Hard Interventions
papers.tldr: The paper characterizes which causal graphs remain indistinguishable under hard interventions and provides a sound algorithm for learning from multiple intervention datasets.

papers.title: Decoding Causal Structure: End-to-End Mediation Pathways Inference
papers.tldr: SIGMA discovers mediation pathways and estimates their effects while propagating uncertainty about the underlying causal structure.

papers.title: Differentiable Constraint-Based Causal Discovery
papers.tldr: Differentiable d-separation scores enable gradient-based causal discovery that directly optimizes conditional independence constraints.

papers.title: Differentiable Cyclic Causal Discovery Under Unmeasured Confounders
papers.tldr: DCCD-CONF learns nonlinear causal graphs with feedback loops and hidden confounders from interventional data.

papers.title: Differentiable Structure Learning and Causal Discovery for General Binary Data
papers.tldr: This framework learns complex discrete dependencies while characterizing which causal structures observational data can and cannot distinguish.

papers.title: Estimating Interventional Distributions with Uncertain Causal Graphs through Meta-Learning
papers.tldr: MACE-TNP learns to approximate Bayesian intervention predictions that average over uncertain causal structures and mechanisms.

papers.title: Faster Generic Identification in Tree-Shaped Structural Causal Models
papers.tldr: A faster algorithm reduces generic identification time for tree-shaped linear causal models from O(n^6) to O(n^3 log² n).

papers.title: Flow based approach for Dynamic Temporal Causal models with non-Gaussian or Heteroscedastic Noises
papers.tldr: FANTOM jointly discovers temporal regimes and causal graphs while accommodating non-Gaussian noise and changing noise variance.

papers.title: Less Greedy Equivalence Search
papers.tldr: LGES makes causal graph search more selective, improving measured speed and accuracy while preserving sample-limit recovery guarantees.

papers.title: Meta-D2AG: Causal Graph Learning with Interventional Dynamic Data
papers.tldr: Meta-D2AG uses online meta-learning to adapt causal graphs across changing time-series domains assumed to result from interventions.

papers.title: Near-Optimal Experiment Design in Linear non-Gaussian Cyclic Models
papers.tldr: A matching-based view of causal ambiguity yields a provably near-optimal intervention policy for linear non-Gaussian systems with possible cycles.

papers.title: Pattern-Guided Adaptive Prior for Structure Learning
papers.tldr: PGAP detects graph patterns caused by mismatched prior information and adaptively adjusts causal structure learning to reduce the resulting errors.

papers.title: Quantifying Distributional Invariance in Causal Subgraph for IRM-Free Graph Generalization
papers.tldr: The paper uses a theoretical link between distributional stability and representation norm to discover causal subgraphs without invariant risk minimization.

papers.title: Root Cause Analysis of Outliers with Missing Structural Knowledge
papers.tldr: Under single-root-cause and polytree assumptions, marginal anomaly scores support efficient root-cause analysis even with little post-fault data.

papers.title: Score-informed Neural Operator for Enhancing Ordering-based Causal Discovery
papers.tldr: SciNO stabilizes score-based causal ordering and combines its probability estimates with autoregressive priors to improve LLM causal reasoning.

papers.title: A Recursive Decomposition Framework for Causal Structure Learning in the Presence of Latent Variables
papers.tldr: DiCoLa makes causal discovery more computationally efficient by recursively solving and recombining smaller problems while allowing hidden variables.

papers.title: Causal Discovery for Irregularly Time Series with Consistency Guarantees
papers.tldr: ReTimeCausal alternates missing-data completion and causal graph learning to encourage consistency when time series are irregularly sampled.

papers.title: Causal Preference Elicitation
papers.tldr: Targeted questions about causal edges help a Bayesian discovery system learn more from limited, potentially noisy expert input.

papers.title: Causal Structure Learning for Sparse Matrix Fill-in Reduction
papers.tldr: A graph-learning method reduces sparse-matrix fill-in by targeting small structural patterns that cause new nonzero entries.

papers.title: CauScale: Neural Causal Discovery at Scale
papers.tldr: CauScale combines compressed data representations and shared attention with two-stream reasoning to scale causal discovery to 1,000-node inference.

papers.title: Credibility-Aware Weighting Federated Causal Discovery for Time Series
papers.tldr: Fed-CAW combines local causal graphs using edge reliability, aligned time scales, and differentially private statistics.

papers.title: Global Directional Priors with Local Statistical Validation for Scalable Causal Discovery
papers.tldr: OCMB uses approximate global ordering to keep local causal tests small, with parent recovery guaranteed under a high-recall ordering assumption.

papers.title: PACER: Acyclic Causal Discovery from Large-scale Interventional Data
papers.tldr: PACER searches only acyclic causal graphs, scaling to thousands of variables with reported speedups of up to two orders of magnitude.

papers.title: Regret-Based Federated Causal Discovery with Unknown Interventions
papers.tldr: I-PERI uses differences induced by unknown client interventions to refine causal graphs in federated learning, with convergence and privacy guarantees.

papers.title: Root Cause Analysis of Failures in Microservices via Bayesian Root Cause Discovery
papers.tldr: BRCD uses partial pre-failure causal structure and Bayesian graph sampling to identify microservice root causes with limited failure data.

papers.title: SCOUT: Cyclic Causal Discovery Under Soft Interventions with Unknown Targets
papers.tldr: SCOUT learns nonlinear causal graphs with feedback loops and unknown soft-intervention targets using normalizing flows.

papers.title: The Fisher Dimension: Instance-Dependent Complexity for Causal Discovery
papers.tldr: The Fisher dimension characterizes instance-specific data requirements for causal equivalence-class recovery through the weakest partial correlation that must be detected.

papers.title: TopoDistill: Distilling Global System Topology for Causal Discovery in Multivariate Time Series
papers.tldr: TopoDistill transfers multivariate neighborhood structure into single-variable time-series embeddings to improve causal discovery under noise.

papers.title: Towards Completeness in Causal Discovery from Soft Interventions with Known Targets
papers.tldr: The paper identifies missing causal orientations in I-FCI and offers complete enumeration and efficient local rules to recover more information.
